presentation.summary: Connect Tracearr to Silo through a focused Jellyfin-compatible bridge.
presentation.description_markdown: Tracearr Bridge exposes Silo sessions, users, libraries, media metadata, artwork, watch history, and stream termination to Tracearr as a Jellyfin-compatible server. It implements only the routes Tracearr needs. This fork preserves the original project's MIT attribution.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Install the plugin and open **Tracearr Bridge** settings.
2. Set the native Silo API URL, an administrator-owned Silo API key, a separate bridge API key, and a listener address.
3. Expose the listener port to Tracearr and enable the listener task at Silo startup.
4. Add the listener to Tracearr as a Jellyfin server and use the bridge API key.

capabilities.description: Start the listener at Silo startup and verify its local health.

global_config_schema.title: Bridge settings
global_config_schema.description: Connection and listener settings for the Tracearr bridge.

fields.label: Native Silo API URL
fields.description: The native API URL as seen from the Silo process, normally http://127.0.0.1:8080.

fields.label: Silo administrator API key
fields.description: Administrator-owned key used by the plugin to read monitoring data and control sessions.

fields.label: Tracearr bridge API key
fields.description: Separate token Tracearr uses to authenticate to this plugin's listener.

fields.label: Listener address
fields.description: Address bound by the Jellyfin-compatible listener.

fields.label: Server name
fields.description: Name shown by Tracearr for this Silo server.
